description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Resource_String class, which is a plugin resource for the Smarty templating engine. It manages string-based template resources, including loading, decoding (base64/urlencoded), and generating unique resource identifiers.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_String
classes.description: A resource handler class for managing string-based templates within the Smarty templating system, providing methods for loading, decoding, and resource identification.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata such as UID, filepath, and timestamp based on the source name and template directory.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template content from the resource, decoding it if necessary.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a resource string if it starts with 'base64' or 'urlencode', otherwise returns it unchanged.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Generates a unique resource name for the string resource, used within the Smarty system.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns an empty string; method for determining the basename of the resource.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Indicates whether timestamp checks are enabled; always returns false for string resources.
